title: Apple to Launch iPhone 18 Pro in India After Labor Day
summary: Apple is expected to launch its new iPhone 18 Pro series in India after the US Labor Day holiday, which falls on September 4. The new iPhones are rumored to feature improved cameras and processors. The prices of the new iPhones may increase by up to ₹18,000 compared to the previous models.
summary_points: Apple is expected to launch its new iPhone 18 Pro series in India after the US Labor Day holiday
The new iPhones are rumored to feature improved cameras and processors
The prices of the new iPhones may increase by up to ₹18,000 compared to the previous models
The launch date has not been officially confirmed by Apple
The new iPhone 18 Pro series is expected to be available in India after September 4
